title: Lyndon Oversized Watchcoat
notes: Shopify multi-color product, URL requests ?color=brown+melange (decodes to 'brown melange'). og:image and JSON-LD Product.image both point at the DEFAULT (black) variant (CA-AUG--15472). The brown-melange gallery (CA-AUG--13942/13952/14072/14123/14232/14352) is inside <div data-color="brown melange"> (space-separated), but the page ALSO has a parallel <div data-color="brown-melange"> (hyphenated) for the SSLD lightbox containing the same brown-melange shots. The hint extractor reads ?color=brown+melange as 'brown melange' so only the space-form container matches; the hyphenated container's images are wrongly tagged as variant-mismatch. Black/khaki shots must NOT appear in the picked images.
